assistant.coding-denied: Code edits are denied: this template is for personal work and never changes a repository.
assistant.verify-gated: Running a verify step asks first, since this template does no coding work of its own.
assistant.shell-gated: Every shell command asks first: personal work runs nothing on this machine without your approval.
assistant.fs-workspace-denied: Writing into a repo workspace is denied, because this template does no repo work.
assistant.fs-write-gated: Any other file write asks first, so nothing on disk changes without you.
assistant.net-gated: A connection to any host asks first: this template allows no network egress by default.
assistant.net-search: The Queen's keyless web search runs without a card; no host pattern could cover the engines it rotates through.
assistant.net-fetch-gated: Reading a web page with read_url asks first for every host, so you see where the Queen wants to go.
assistant.mcp-calendar: Tools on the MCP server named calendar run without a card when they report themselves read-only; its other tools ask.
assistant.mcp-notes: Tools on the MCP server named notes run without a card when they report themselves read-only; its other tools ask.
assistant.mcp-gated: Any other MCP tool asks first.
assistant.email-read: Reading mail through an email-bound MCP server runs without a card.
assistant.email-send-gated: Sending mail, or any other email side effect, asks first and the card shows what would go out.
assistant.browse-read: Reading a page's state (snapshot, screenshot, console) runs without a card.
assistant.browse-act-gated: Acting on a page (navigating, clicking, typing, running JavaScript) asks first.

builder.coding-workspace: A worker may edit files in its own disposable worktree; nothing reaches your branch until you approve the patch.
builder.verify-workspace: A worker may run its verify step in its worktree; skep still re-verifies the patch itself before it can land.
builder.shell-git-status: A worker may run git status without a card, since it only reads the repository's state; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-git-diff: A worker may run git diff without a card, since it only shows changes; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-git-log: A worker may run git log without a card, since it only reads history; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-pytest: A worker may run pytest without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-uv-run-pytest: A worker may run uv run pytest without a card to test its change in the project's environment; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-uv-sync: A worker may run uv sync without a card to install the project's Python dependencies; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-npm-test: A worker may run npm test without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-npm-install: A worker may run npm install without a card to install the project's packages; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-pnpm-test: A worker may run pnpm test without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-pnpm-install: A worker may run pnpm install without a card to install the project's packages; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-cargo-test: A worker may run cargo test without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-go-test: A worker may run go test without a card to test its change; the Queen's own shell still asks.
builder.shell-learnable: Any other shell command asks first, and an approval can be remembered for that exact command line; the floor's denies still apply.
builder.fs-workspace: Writes inside the run's workspace are allowed: it is a disposable copy, and changes reach your repo only as an approved patch.
builder.fs-write-gated: A write anywhere outside the workspace asks first, so nothing beyond the copy changes without you.
builder.net-pypi: Workers may connect to pypi.org (that host only, not its subdomains) to install Python packages.
builder.net-pythonhosted: Workers may connect to files.pythonhosted.org, where PyPI serves package files.
builder.net-npm: Workers may connect to registry.npmjs.org to install JavaScript packages.
builder.net-go: Workers may connect to proxy.golang.org to download Go modules.
builder.net-gated: A connection to any other host asks first.
builder.net-search: The Queen's keyless web search runs without a card; no host pattern could cover the engines it rotates through.
builder.net-fetch-gated: Reading a web page with read_url asks first for every host, so you see where the Queen wants to go.
builder.mcp-gated: Every MCP tool asks first: coding work needs none by default.
builder.email-read-gated: Reading mail asks first: coding work has no reason to open your inbox.
builder.email-send-gated: Sending mail, or any other email side effect, asks first and the card shows what would go out.
builder.browse-read-gated: Reading a browser page's state asks first: coding work does not browse by default.
builder.browse-act-gated: Acting on a page (navigating, clicking, typing, running JavaScript) asks first.
